svg.text: Within a cell, without a TF list: NMF splits expression into programs that cells mix.
All values ≥ 0 → programs only add up,
they never cancel each other out
cNMF: rerun many times, keep the consensus
② Every cell is a mixture
A cluster gives each cell one label;
NMF lets it carry several programs
both clusters — no cluster shows it
⚠️ k is a choice, like clustering resolution — check stability. A program is not a pathway until you annotate it.
💡 WGCNA (bulk) does a similar job with hard modules; in single cells it needs metacells, one cell type at a time.
